newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX says PSC says it fixed Caller ID well.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX says PSC says it fixed Caller ID well.

text.p: NYNEX Corp, responding to allegations in a class action suit proceeding against it, on Wednesday pointed to a New York Public Service Commission report that said the company acted effectively to correct a problem that resulted in some customers' phone numbers being revealed against their wishes.
Earlier Wednesday, attorneys for plaintiffs in the class action suit said a New York State appeals court had denied NYNEX's motion to dismiss the suit.

The suit is about NYNEX's failure several years ago to protect the confidentiality of at least 30,000 customers who had asked to have their phone numbers shielded from the company's "Caller I.D." service.
The problem was the result of a computer error.

While the company would not comment directly on the case or the recent ruling in the plaintiffs' favor, it noted a 1995 Public Service Commission report that said it acted reasonably to correct the problem.
"After the problem was identified, effective actions were taken to protect consumers from further harm," the commission report said.
